name: strix-versioned-recoverable-local-credential-678a
instr:
Strix cannot safely migrate credentials or recover interrupted writes today. Make each store accept its valid legacy form and return an equivalent provider-specific record in a versioned envelope.

Preserve Codex account identity, refresh eligibility, and sibling providers. Preserve managed-platform origin, workspace, scope ceiling, profile, and token replacement. Preserve viewer email validation, relay token availability, expiry parsing, and local history gating.

Make replacement atomic. Malformed, truncated, or structurally invalid input must preserve its original bytes for explicit recovery and return one stable, secret-free result across repeated reads without duplicate artifacts. After interruption at every `RecoverySeam`, restore the last complete record or report recoverable ambiguity. Identify discarded candidates only through secret-free metadata.

Serialize mutations by observed generation so stale refresh, scope, workspace, or verification updates cannot overwrite newer state. Logout must remove only the selected provider state and follow its local recovery behavior.

Restrict credentials, temporary candidates, backups, locks, and quarantine files to owner-only access. If temporary-file cleanup fails, report its path without contents. Commands and request consumers must distinguish every `CredentialStatus`, avoid network access for unusable records, and retain recovery metadata after successful local mutation.
